program_overview.title: App Making for Kids
program_overview.tagline: The family phone becomes the launch device: real apps designed and built by the child, installed and used at home, in six honest months.
program_overview.description:
Few moments beat a child opening an app on a real phone and saying "I made this". This live online course delivers that moment repeatedly for ages 8 to 12: visual programming logic learned through play, then real mobile apps built with block-based tools, screens designed on paper first, logic snapped together, data saved, and every build installed on the family phone for genuine daily use.

The course keeps its promises honest: no app-store publishing pressure, no monetization talk for children, just skill and delight. Apps are shared safely with family through test links, and the course ends with a capstone, an app for the family, planned, built, tested by a real user and presented at demo day.

Six months at two live classes a week plus two to three hours of playful practice, with two more months in hand when needed. Homework after every class, a mixed challenge every month, and a final exam, capstone demo plus a friendly viva, that decides the certificate with a free retest. Real apps, real users, real pride.
what_makes_this_different: Apps land on real phones: every month ends with something installed and used at home
Design before blocks: children sketch screens on paper like real product designers
No store pressure, no money talk: skill and joy are the whole syllabus at this age
Family as users: testing with real people is taught as the heart of app making
An honest 6-month arc with 2 months in hand
Real assessment, gently done: monthly mixed challenges and a final capstone exam with a free retest

faqs.question: What apps will my child actually build?
faqs.answer: Fifteen-plus working apps across six months: soundboards, quizzes, drawing pads, trackers and games in the middle months, and a capstone, an app for the family such as a chore chart or pet log, installed on a real phone, tested by real family users and presented at demo day.

faqs.question: Will the apps go on the App Store or Play Store?
faqs.answer: No, and that is deliberate honesty: store publishing involves adult accounts, fees and review processes that do not belong in a course for 8-12 year olds. Apps are installed directly on family phones and shared safely through test links, which is everything a child needs for real users and real pride. Store publishing is taught honestly in our teen app course, where it belongs.

faqs.question: How long does the course take?
faqs.answer: Six months at 2 live classes a week plus 2 to 3 hours of playful practice takes a child from zero to the demo-day capstone in app making. The course keeps two more months in hand for children who need more repetition, no rushing and no penalty.

faqs.question: How is my child assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No, and it is all gentle: classwork in every session, a small homework build after every class, a mixed challenge at the end of every month that revisits earlier skills, and a final exam, a capstone demo plus a friendly viva and short quiz. Passing earns the certificate; a child who falls short gets focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: What tools are used, and are they free?
faqs.answer: Free block-based app builders in the MIT App Inventor family, run in the browser, with accounts set up alongside a parent. A computer for building and any family phone for testing is the whole kit.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 children. A mini batch of 3-4 children is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International families pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial class?
faqs.answer: Yes, a free demo class with no commitment: book at learn.modernagecoders.com/contact or message us on WhatsApp at +91 91233 66161. Parents are welcome to sit in.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Live, always: small groups with a real teacher, never pre-recorded videos. Children build during class and get unstuck on the spot.
